_comment: Single source of truth for the PWA precache tiers. Consumed by ui/vite.config.ts (build.manifest), scripts/pwa/generate-precache-tiers.mjs (tier classification + dist/precache-tiers.json) and scripts/pwa/check-precache-budget.mjs (CI budget gate). Edits belong here, never in the two scripts.
_tiers: shell = precached on first install for every visitor (target <= 3 MiB). host = warmed into the runtime cache after a host signs in, or immediately in standalone. on-demand = never precached; runtime-cached (stale-while-revalidate) the first time a route that needs it is opened.
_totalBudgetNote: Raised from 20 MiB to 22 MiB on 2026-11-04: the multi-track video editor needs `@remotion/media` (the only Video/Audio the web renderer supports) plus its mediabunny dependency, which adds ~1.3 MiB to the on-demand tier. Nothing moved into shell or host.
_shellSources: Source paths (substring match, relative to ui/src) forced into the shell tier. Normally empty: a chunk statically imported by a shell chunk is promoted automatically.
_hostPrefixes: Source paths (prefix match, relative to ui/src) that belong to the host tier.
_onDemandPrefixes: Heavy, task-specific modules that must never be precached. Prefix match, relative to ui/src.
_onDemandPackages: Package names whose chunks are always on-demand (matched against the chunk source path).
_shellStatic: Non-JS/CSS files every visitor needs. Explicit list (not a glob) so a 370 KiB favicon.svg or an unused QR image can never slip in. Sizes are checked by the budget gate.
